claim: Baumanière has 53 rooms and suites across 5 buildings (L'Oustau, Le Manoir, Flora, Carita, La Maison de Famille) on the estate that also houses the L'Oustau de Baumanière 3-Michelin-star restaurant.
quote: 53 rooms and suites spread across 5 living areas on the estate

claim: Baumanière is a 5-star Relais & Châteaux hotel; 2026 room rates run €325–€580 (classic) up to €900–€1,500 (Suite Prestige Luxe); hotel closed 25 Jan–5 Feb 2026, restaurant 26 Jan–6 Mar 2026.
quote: Classic room: 325€ to 580€ … Suite Prestige Luxe: 900€ to 1500€. The annual closure of the hotel is from 25 January to 5 February 2026.

claim: Baumanière is a five-minute walk from the cobbled streets of Les Baux-de-Provence; a private door on the hotel grounds opens onto a footpath up to the village.
quote: you actually see the village from the Oustau and there is a door leading you on a path all the way to the village in just five minutes

claim: Baumanière holds a 4.3 / 5 rating from 1,963 TripAdvisor reviews; recent guests describe a 20–25-minute walk to the village in addition to a complimentary shuttle.
quote: 20 to 25-minute walk or conveniently by hotel shuttle to the village

claim: La Riboto de Taven (Taven Résidences) is a 3-room luxury B&B in Vallon de la Fontaine beneath the cliffs of Les Baux, rated 4.9 / 5 from 69 reviews and ranked #1 B&B in the village; two rooms are troglodyte (carved into rock).
quote: Vallon de la Fontaine, 13520 Les Baux de Provence … 4.9 of 5 stars (69 reviews) … 3 rooms … #1 of 1 B&B in Les Baux de Provence

claim: Le Mas d'Aigret is an authentic 17th-century farmhouse, partially carved out of the rock, a 5-minute walk from the village of Les Baux, with views over the Alpilles and the Château.
quote: 17th-century farmhouse, partially carved out of the rock, ideally located just 5 minutes' walk from the village

claim: Le Mas d'Aigret is a 4-star hotel with 19 rooms plus 3 newer terrace rooms (22 total), pricing €125–€385 per night (2025), restaurant on site; address 555 Route des Oliviers (D27a).
quote: 4 star hotel … 19 comfortable rooms … and since 2024: 3 new rooms with terraces … €125 to €385

claim: Le Mas d'Aigret holds 4.6 / 5 across 745 TripAdvisor reviews; guests highlight the location and view but it requires descent from the east side of the village.
quote: Rating: 4.6/5 (745 reviews) … short walk to Les Baux village

claim: Hostellerie de la Reine-Jeanne is a family-run small hotel/restaurant in the village of Les Baux with only 4 bedrooms, address 4 Rue Porte Mages; TripAdvisor 4.0 / 5 (123 reviews); reviewers warn rooms above the restaurant have no air-con and can be noisy.
quote: only four bedrooms … there isn't air conditioning, and with the restaurant below and late night partying, light sleepers may find it harder to sleep

claim: Hotel Benvengudo is a 4-star country house at 1800 Route d'Arles (D78F), 13520 Les Baux-de-Provence, on the same road that fronts Baumanière but further out.
quote: 1800 route d'Arles D78F 13520 Les Baux de Provence

claim: Hotel Benvengudo has 28 rooms, 4.5 / 5 across 710 TripAdvisor reviews, $238–$626 per night; recent guests note ⚠ it is not walkable to the village or restaurants without a car.
quote: would not stay here again without our own transportation … 4-star property with 28 rooms and suites

claim: Domaine de Manville is a 5-star luxury hotel with 30 rooms and 9 villas, an 18-hole golf course, spa, and the Michelin-starred restaurant Aupiho by chef Lieven Van Aken.
quote: 30 rooms decorated in a unique style and 9 villas … Michelin-starred restaurant Aupiho

claim: Domaine de Manville is approximately 1 mile (1.6 km) from the centre of Les Baux-de-Provence, a 12-minute walk to the clifftop castle; TripAdvisor 4.6 / 5 across 1,619 reviews.
quote: 1 mile from the heart of Les Baux-de-Provence … 12-minute stroll from the clifftop castle

claim: L'Oustau de Baumanière restaurant sits in the Val d'Enfer below the medieval village, on Route du Val d'Enfer / Route d'Arles, 13520 Les Baux-de-Provence.
quote: walking routes in the area pass by the Oustaou de Baumanière hotel along Route du Val d'Enfer

claim: L'Oustau de Baumanière holds three Michelin stars under chef Glenn Viel.
quote: L'Oustau de Baumanière – Les Baux-de-Provence – a MICHELIN Guide Restaurant
